result.title: Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding. These findings show that high VAD performance should not be interpreted as evidence of abnormal-motion modeling without auditing the reliability of the person-observation pipeline. Our study provides a systematic protocol for evaluating observation-quality shortcuts and for assessing whether motion-based discrimination survives explicit control of detection, pose-estimation, and tracking reliability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对以人为中心的视频异常检测，检验基于运动的异常判别究竟反映任务相关运动信息，还是检测、姿态估计与跟踪带来的观测质量差异；提出包含质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化和稳健性分析的评估框架，并在 UCF-Crime 上显示质量特征可构成强捷径，经基数匹配后多线索运动才稳定优于质量特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观测质量捷径审计＋混杂控制」的评估思路可能可迁移到 LVR 评测：用于核查 latent 推理的判别究竟来自真实视觉证据，还是来自输入质量、检测可靠性等代理线索，具体对应关系供核查。
